question:
The pie chart shows the percentage of different kind of expenditure while making a mobile phone.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c6a9f3bf6e16d5d4a14fc4d3f248dfd0ee0ba07d3a78280f8a6963a878041de2.png] 

If the total cost of making 250 mobile phones is Rs. 25 lakh, then by how much will the packaging cost of a single mobile phone be less than its cost on technology?
solution:
**Given:**

Total cost for 250 phones = ₹25 lakh

Packaging cost percentage = 5%

Technology cost percentage = 15%

**Calculation:**

The cost of a single phone = ₹25 lakh / 250 = ₹10,000

The packaging cost (5% of ₹10,000) = ₹10,000 × 5% = ₹500

The technology cost (15% of ₹10,000) = ₹10,000 × 15% = ₹1,500

Difference = ₹1,500 - ₹500 = ₹1,000

**∴ The packaging cost is ₹1,000 less than the technology cost.**
